youtube.title: Type a word, fill it with a loop: funkbox's new text masks, in three shaders
youtube.description:
Type a word. Fill it with a loop.
New in funkbox: a layer's mask can be typed text, with a bevel set by three numbers (width, strength, angle). One mask, three shaders, each loop checked seamless by machine. No video model; this Short rendered in under 40 seconds on a 4-core CPU with no GPU.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
